exploratory.statement: This is an exploratory operational prompt-utility diagnostic on already-used validation data; it may only inform the next preregistration and cannot support a final accuracy or promotion conclusion.

isolation.restricted_val_report_parsed_note: the prior contrastive report JSON is byte-hashed by the pins and additionally read only for the S4 G1/G4/G5/G7 gate booleans; its validation statistics are never used as a metric source

P1_B_correct_minus_wrong_selector_mass_k.definition: arm B deployed correct-prompt selector minus the same-image other-task wrong-prompt selector, retained spatial-target mass at K48
P1_B_correct_minus_wrong_selector_mass_k.aggregation: per-image grounding/pointing mean then median across the three seeds, then paired effect over independent images

P2_B_minus_A_correct_minus_wrong_gap_mas.definition: arm B minus arm A of the (correct-prompt minus wrong-prompt) deployed selector retained spatial-target mass gap at K48
P2_B_minus_A_correct_minus_wrong_gap_mas.aggregation: per-image grounding/pointing mean then median across the three seeds, then paired effect over independent images

S1.definition: arm B grounding and pointing K48 correct-minus-wrong retained-mass means are both > 0

S2.definition: arm B K48 correct-minus-wrong selected-set NDCG mean > 0

S3.definition: arm B K48 correct-vs-wrong selected Jaccard mean < 0.95

S4.definition: prior contrastive report G1/G4/G5/G7 all pass and every pinned input SHA matches

decision.rule: supported iff P1, P2 and S1-S4 all pass

prior_report_reference.note: The prior contrastive report JSON is parsed only for these gate booleans (S4); its validation-statistics metrics and val-samples CSV are never parsed and never used as a metric source.

limitations: Exploratory diagnostic on already-used validation; not a final accuracy conclusion.
No internal test NPZ was resolved, hashed, opened, parsed or scored.
The val split was already used during development; this is not final or CV-Bench accuracy.
No hardware synthesis, latency or speedup claim.
The prior contrastive decision PROMPT_CONTRASTIVE_STUDENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED is unchanged; this diagnostic only adds exploratory evidence.
The prior report JSON is parsed only for the S4 gate booleans; its statistics and val-samples CSV are never metric sources.
Per-image statistics treat the 38 images as independent units.
The selector chain is descriptive; passing P1/P2 does not by itself establish task accuracy or promotion.
